settings.name: api_key
settings.label: API key
settings.help: xAI API key from console.x.ai. Stored in CMS settings; never sent to the browser.

settings.name: model
settings.label: Model
settings.help: Chat model id. Prefer grok-4.3 for CMS translation (cost/quality); grok-4.5 for hard coding/agents. See xAI docs for current names.

settings.name: context_style
settings.label: Site / style context
settings.help: Provider-specific profile: short description of this site and expected tone for this xAI setup (e.g. music education app, friendly student UI). Shared AI options (provider pick, confirm, only-missing) are under Site settings → AI.
